description: End-to-end smoke test for the cloudflared connector (docker-compose framework). Requires env var TUNNEL_TOKEN set to a real Cloudflare Tunnel connector token (base64 JSON from the Zero Trust dashboard / `cloudflared tunnel token <name>` — NOT a DNS API token). The livetest stack-manager injects process.env.TUNNEL_TOKEN into the freshly-created cloudflare-tunnel stack and binds it — exactly the production flow. Without the env var the runner drops the scenario (requires_env). With it set, the LXC boots Docker, `docker compose up` starts the cloudflared service with restart: unless-stopped, and the connector reaches the Cloudflare edge (the nested VM has NAT'd outbound internet). The framework docker-services check asserts the service is running. NOTE: a stale cloudflare-tunnel_default stack from a prior run is reused (not refilled), so delete it first if you change the token.
